description_en: Queries the Security Center dashboard version configuration
description_zh: 查询安全大屏版本配置
name: DescribeScreenVersionConfig

AssetLevel.description_en: The number of purchased server authorizations
AssetLevel.description_zh: 已购买的服务器授权数

IsTrialVersion.description_en:
Indicates whether the current Security Center edition is a trial version. Valid values:
0: Non-trial version.
1: Trial version
IsTrialVersion.description_zh:
当前云安全中心版本是否是试用版本。取值：
0：非试用版本
1：试用版本

ReleaseTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the Security Center instance expires. Unit: milliseconds.
If you do not renew the instance within 7 days after it expires, your paid edition instance is downgraded to the Free Edition. You can no longer use the features of the paid edition, and your Security Center configuration data and historical alert data (such as DDoS alerts) become inaccessible. In this case, you must repurchase a paid edition to re-enable the service. For more information, see [Purchase Security Center]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42308.html）
ReleaseTime.description_zh:
云安全中心实例到期时间戳，单位为毫秒。
如果服务到期7天后您未进行续费，您的付费版实例将降级为免费版，您将无法继续使用付费版本的功能，您之前的云安全中心配置数据和历史告警数据（例如：DDoS告警等）将无法查看。此时，您只有通过重新购买来启用云安全中心付费版服务。更多信息请参见[购买云安全中心]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42308.html）

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The China Chinese Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

SasLog.description_en:

0: Not purchased.
1: Purchased
SasLog.description_zh:
是否已购买日志分析。取值：
0：未购买
1：已购买

SasScreen.description_en:
Indicates whether the security dashboard has been purchased. Valid values:
0: Not purchased.
1: Purchased
SasScreen.description_zh:
是否已购买安全大屏。取值：
0：未购买

Version.description_en:
The purchased edition of Security Center. Valid values:  
1: Free Edition. 
3: Enterprise Edition.
5: Pro Edition.
6: Anti-virus Edition.    
7: Ultimate Edition.   
8: Multi-version Edition.   
10: Value-added services only

已购买的云安全中心版本。 取值：  
1：免费版 
3：企业版
5：高级版
6：防病毒版    
7：旗舰版   
8：多版本   
10：仅采购增值服务
